text:
Nora (PM): Quick UX catch: our users asked for clearer hierarchy between org and project spend. Considering adding a sticky scope bar above the spend canvas. Thoughts?
Diego (Design): Sticky scope bar is good. Could include scope label + token/USD toggle + persistent invoice CTA.
Sam (Analytics): Behavioral note: sticky CTAs increase discoverability but reduce visible chart area. Need to balance.
Hannah (Frontend): Should be fine if we keep sticky bar 56px tall. Also ensure it doesn't cover in-page modals on smaller screens.
Diego (Design): Copy for scope bar: "Scope: Organization — All projects" and when switched: "Scope: Project — Marketing site". Use a clear visual divider.
ux-helper: Accessibility reminder: scope bar elements must be grouped in a landmark region `role=region` with `aria-label="Billing scope"`.
Nora (PM): Invoice placement debate: header CTA vs per-project; earlier data showed users expect a top-level invoice CTA. Keep top-level primary and per-row secondary?
Sam (Analytics): Confirmed. Top-level primary yields higher conversion for downloads and reduces support tickets.
Hannah (Frontend): Implementation: per-row secondary should be visually subtle but keyboard reachable. Add `aria-describedby` linking to tooltip text.
Diego (Design): Visual nit: token toggle needs larger hit target — 44px min. Also ensure color states meet contrast.
Nora (PM): Chart layout: proposal to show an overview timeseries at top and then compact ledger below. Alternative is side-by-side chart + ledger. Any accessibility pros/cons?
Sam (Analytics): Side-by-side is nicer on wide screens; stacked (overview then ledger) is more mobile friendly. Adaptive layout based on breakpoints recommended.
Hannah (Frontend): I'll implement responsive breakpoints. For mobile, collapse charts behind an expand button.
Diego (Design): Also propose adding a lightweight 'scope legend' inside the header with project color swatches. Helps correlate ledger sparklines to chart lines.
ux-helper: Suggestion: each color swatch must have accessible name and non-color indicator for color-blind users (e.g., pattern or dot style).
Nora (PM): UX copy change: replace "Token view" with "Display: Tokens" and tooltip: "Show usage in token units".
Sam (Analytics): Also recommend saving last-view preference (chart vs ledger) per user. That reduces flip-flop in experiments.
Hannah (Frontend): Will persist in local storage + server when logged in.
Nora (PM): Final ask: update the 'Export' dropdown to say "Download invoice (CSV)" and "Download usage (CSV)" instead of generic labels.
Diego (Design): Spacing: for the compact ledger rows use 8px vertical padding, and left-align project names with 16px gutter.
ux-helper: Checklist: ["Sticky scope bar role=region + aria-label", "Top-level 'Download invoice (CSV)' CTA", "Per-row 'Download usage (CSV)' secondary", "Token toggle min-hit 44px + tooltip", "Responsive: side-by-side on wide, stacked on mobile", "Project legend with non-color cues", "Persist last-view preference"]
Nora (PM): Thanks. Diego will update mocks and Hannah will prototype sticky bar behavior. Review in tomorrow's design crit.
Diego (Design): I'll post updated frames and accessibility notes in Figma.
Nora (PM): Closing thread.
